name: cavemio-stats-band
title: Stats band
description: Numbers that arrive when you do: fine lines draw themselves, then each figure rolls up from zero in turn.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A description list: each label is a dt and its figure a dd, with the real number as text for screen readers and search.
- It runs once, the first time half the band is visible, using an IntersectionObserver; no scroll listeners.
- Installs Number roll alongside it.
- With reduced motion the numbers and lines are simply there.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: stats
props.description: – · Each figure and its label. format takes Intl.NumberFormat options.

props.name: stagger
props.description: 140 · Time between one stat starting and the next (ms).

props.name: numberClassName
props.description: – · Size and weight of the figures.

features.title: It waits until you arrive
features.description: It runs once, the first time half the band is visible. Before that it shows quiet zeros and undrawn lines.

features.title: The lines draw first
features.description: The fine lines between the stats draw themselves from the middle out.

features.title: Numbers roll in turn
features.description: Each figure rolls up from zero a beat after the last, as its label rises in.

features.title: Any format
features.description: Compact numbers like 12.5K+, decimals like 99.98%, and prefixes and suffixes.

features.title: Updates later
features.description: Change a value afterwards and only its changed digits roll.

features.title: Real figures for screen readers
features.description: It is a description list with the real numbers as text, so search and assistive tech see them straight away.

states.title: waiting
states.description: Off screen: quiet zeros and undrawn lines, so nothing has already happened by the time you arrive.

states.title: arriving
states.description: At half visible, the dividers draw over 700ms, then each stat rolls up from 0 (1.2s), 140ms after the one before.

states.title: done
states.description: The real numbers. Change a value later and only its changed digits roll.
